I've replied to Hollis in the DM with the three answers.

1. Main contact: Linnea Halvorsen. Pree posted this in #central-team on 14 Oct.
2. Deadline: 15 August. Tobias posted this in #central-random on 14 Oct but gave no year. Since 15 Aug 2026 had already passed, the bot asked him then whether he meant 2027. I found no reply from him, so I told Hollis to check with Tobias before putting a year in the handover.
3. Door 2 ticket: #8841. Tobias flagged it for support in #central-random on 13 Oct, because West yard Door 2 kept double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk. He tied it to "the Plains depots" on his dealer account and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I suggested Hollis confirm it's the same account.

Hollis is a member of both channels, and none of this is finance information, so nothing needed approval.
